tools.name: get_account_status
tools.description: Check whether the connected WhatsApp line is online, its phone number, display name, and recent connection health.

tools.name: list_chats
tools.description: List recent WhatsApp chats (1:1 and groups) ordered by most recent activity from the 7-day sync buffer, with names and last message preview.

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Search WhatsApp contacts and groups by name, pushname, or phone number to find their chat ID.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search recent WhatsApp messages containing a text query in the 7-day sync buffer, optionally scoped to one chat.

tools.name: get_messages
tools.description: Read recent messages from a specific WhatsApp chat or group (supports pagination via message ID cursor and fromMe filter).

tools.name: get_groups
tools.description: List all WhatsApp groups the line participates in, along with admin status for each group.

tools.name: get_group_members
tools.description: List members of a WhatsApp group and their admin status.

tools.name: get_group_details
tools.description: Inspect metadata and participants of a WhatsApp group from its invite link.

tools.name: get_join_requests
tools.description: List pending membership join requests for a WhatsApp group where you are an admin.

tools.name: check_whatsapp_number
tools.description: Check whether a phone number has an active WhatsApp account and retrieve its JID.

tools.name: convert_lid_to_number
tools.description: Resolve a WhatsApp Linked ID (e.g. '12345@lid') to a phone number.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a text message to a WhatsApp contact or group. Always confirm recipient and content with the user first.

tools.name: send_media
tools.description: Send an image, video, document, or audio file (via public URL or base64) with an optional caption to a WhatsApp chat or group.

tools.name: send_poll
tools.description: Create and send a poll to a WhatsApp group.

tools.name: send_reaction
tools.description: Send an emoji reaction to a WhatsApp message.

tools.name: edit_message
tools.description: Edit the text of a previously sent WhatsApp message.

tools.name: delete_message
tools.description: Delete a previously sent WhatsApp message.

tools.name: add_group_member
tools.description: Add a user to a WhatsApp group where you are an admin.

tools.name: remove_group_member
tools.description: Remove a user from a WhatsApp group where you are an admin.

tools.name: approve_join_requests
tools.description: Approve one or more pending join requests for a WhatsApp group.

tools.name: reject_join_requests
tools.description: Reject one or more pending join requests for a WhatsApp group.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_chats, search_contacts, search_messages, get_messages · Private data: search_contacts, send_message, send_media · Public sink: send_message, send_media, send_poll, send_reaction · Destructive: delete_message, remove_group_member.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_chats, search_contacts, search_messages, get_messages · Private data: search_contacts, send_message, send_media · Public sink: send_message, send_media, send_poll, send_reaction · Destructive: delete_message, remove_group_member

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
